notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded transport-fault route for HLAreportFederateLost to the Requirements Lab's surviving-subscriber and time-regulating-federate requirements. The planner captures the lost federate's active current logical time before automatic-resign cleanup and the callback route rechecks a surviving recipient's subscription before delivery. Catch2 proves the MIM class and parameter values, HLAreliable receive-order callback, selective ordinary and DDM-matching regional subscription under HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE, and the one local default-invalid producer-handle adapter representation. A complementary asynchronous-delivery integration case proves that the report's encoded time-6 parameter is the same inclusive cutoff that releases a queued timestamp-6 application interaction. The broader page-50 TSO cutoff/delivery matrix, remote transport, generic MOM delivery, JUnit/protected review, and conformance remain open. RL-065 records the C++ producer-designator crosswalk gap.
